body:
Observed in the pdca-pdca instance, two independent frozen cycles (issue_317 and issue_372, both 2026-08-01):

- issue_317 §6 C4: exact `./engine/scripts/run-verify.sh` was unavailable at `$PDCA_TARGET` root **and Git stash could not write the read-only worktree index**, so the reviewer had to fall back to a direct unittest run as a red→green substitute.
- issue_372 §6 C4: manual red→green (3/5 failing pre-fix, 5/5 patched) had to substitute for the configured C4 gate because **git stash could not run — the worktree's git index is read-only** in the reviewer sandbox.

This is distinct from #403 (missing T2/T3 gate oracles in the sandbox): even with the oracles present, the sandbox's filesystem confinement makes `.git/index` read-only, so the reviewer cannot stash the patch to reproduce the pre-fix red independently. The C4 verification claim then lands in §6 NEEDS-HUMAN every time instead of being mechanically re-checked.

Suggested directions (either would do):
- grant the reviewer leaf write access to a disposable clone/worktree (so `git stash` / `git checkout` work) while keeping the real target read-only, or
- have the harness supply a pre-fix snapshot (or `git worktree add` a detached copy) into the sandbox so red→green can be re-run without touching the primary index.

Template-vs-instance boundary: this is harness sandbox machinery (reviewer leaf confinement), not instance config, hence filed here.
title: reviewer sandbox: read-only git index blocks stash-based red→green (C4) reproduction
